pairs.subject: model-composed-workspace
pairs.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_glyph/commandPanel/composer/ComposerConnectorsPickerModal.tsx:36 The 'composer' here is a set of person-driven picker modals: the operator picks connectors, events, schedules and messaging channels and applies the selection through onApply. No model chooses or arranges views. A search of the context's files for llm, assistant, undo, region, workspace, streaming and conductor found no hits, so the subject's precondition (a model composing the screen) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_glyph/commandPanel/composer/ComposerPickerShell.tsx:2 The picker shell is opened by the user. No model decides between prose, card, pane or workspace.
src/features/agents/sub_glyph/commandPanel/composer/useOnOpen.ts:10 The draft that is preserved is the operator's own picker selection, not a user arrangement protected against model recomposition.

src/features/agents/sub_glyph/commandPanel/composer/ComposerConnectorsPickerModal.tsx:53 Screen changes come from user clicks that seed and apply a local draft. The model issues no screen verbs that would need undo or stop-restore.
src/features/agents/sub_glyph/commandPanel/composer/ComposerPickerShell.tsx:14 The motion is a modal fade/scale on user open. There is no model-placed or streamed composition to animate.
